out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC UNABLE TO PROVIDE SIGNED EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICIES FOR CURRENT EMPLOYEES.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EH POLICIES PROVIDED VIA EMAIL. PLEASE PRINT OUT A COPY FOR EACH EMPLOYEE AND HAVE EVERYONE READ AND UNDERSTAND THE REQUIREMENTS. EACH EMPLOYEE MUST SIGN A COPY. THESE MUST BE KEPT ONSITE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED CORN AT 44-45F IN THE ONE-DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER. CORN WAS IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: DISPOSED OF. THE COOLER MUST BE TURNED DOWN TO AROUND 35F AND NO HIGHER THAN 38F IN ORDER TO KEEP TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Report to Health Department, Jaundice
violations.observation: Person in charge was not aware of duty to report jaundice to the health department when the employee health policy was reviewed during time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge shall notify the regulatory authority when a food employee is jaundiced. Person in charge and EHS reviewed requirements to report when employee with jaundiced reports for work

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): French fries being held on counter for 4 hours, marked with sticker for start and end time, without written time as a public health control procedures
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. Person in charge and EHS set up a time as public health control document/agreement.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Food or Color Additive, Safe Level of Use
violations.observation: An unsafe or unapproved level of the following approved food or color additives has been identified: observed veggie wash being used above an approved level at 1.78mm/gallon using an approved test kit
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from the addition of unsafe or unapproved food or color additives AND unsafe or unapproved levels of approved foods and color additives. Person in charge called chemical management company to adjust the concentration levels, company scheduled to fix concentration levels

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items.observed degreaser being stored next to boxes of sauces
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. Person in charge moved degreaser to designated. Chemcial storage space

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. Observed fruit flies by the customer service self serve soda fountain.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. Person in charge agreed to have pest control company handle the fruit flies during their next routine visit

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Design
violations.observation: Observe an unapproved handheld bug zapper being stored inside the kitchen area on shelving that was used for dry storage.
violations.corrective_action: If insect control devices electrocute or stun insects, the device shall be designed to catch and hold the insects. Person in charge removed unapproved bug zapper from the kitchen area and agreed to have it removed from the facility.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: observe starch wash being stored under the three compartment sink, sanitize side, where it may be subjected to splashing from the sanitize basin of the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. person in charge move storage barrel of the start wash away from the three compartment sink and stored it next to the dry potato don age rack storage

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The 1 door upright cooler was observed at 43F during the tie of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge called store owner and had the repair company scheduled to repair the 1 door upright cooler Wingstop #52411 (Inspection Date: 08/22/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the walk in cooler is dripping condensation on the food storage boxes from the overhead compressor
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Person in charge agreed to have the repair company fix the walk in cooler so it was no longer dripping condensation

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: observed mold build up on the non food contact surface of the fountain soda dispenser
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS notified person in charge, person in charge tasked an employee to clean the fountain soda dispenser

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed above the three compartment sink drill holes from previous mounting of wash and sanitize chemicals. Observed under the electrical panel in the rear of the kitchen exposed wood that is not properly sealed and a smooth and easily cleanable surface
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Person in charge agreed to have the drill holes and the exposed wood that is not smooth and easily cleanable surface under the electrical panel repaired by next inspection.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED MOP SINK SPLITTER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM WILL ORDER APPROVED MOP SINK SPLITTER.
